intent: Declare the research source and stage it: rename the reserved window column, cast types, derive release_id, lab_id and source_domain

edits.new_content:
version: 2

sources:
  - name: research
    description: >
      The research dataset as delivered (data/frontier_models_pace_the_frontier.csv), loaded
      unchanged by scripts/load_raw.py with every column as VARCHAR. Definitions and rules are
      in data/METHODOLOGY.md.
    schema: raw
    tables:
      - name: frontier_model_candidates
        description: >
          One row per candidate release announced by a frontier lab between 7 Aug and
          12 Oct 2026, counted or not. 52 rows.
        columns:
          - name: window
            description: before, after or outside, derived by the researcher from `date`.
            data_tests:
              - accepted_values:
                  arguments:
                    values: [before, after, outside]
          - name: counted
            description: yes if the row meets the inclusion rules (METHODOLOGY 4.2).
            data_tests:
              - not_null
              - accepted_values:
                  arguments:
                    values: ['yes', 'no']
          - name: date
            description: Announcement date (ISO 8601) under the dating rule (METHODOLOGY 4.5).
            data_tests: [not_null]
          - name: developer
            description: Lab or company.
            data_tests: [not_null]
          - name: model
            description: Model name; combined names mark a single counted unit (METHODOLOGY 4.4).
            data_tests: [unique, not_null]
          - name: tier
            description: Position in the developer's lineup at announcement; blank on most excluded rows.
          - name: release_type
            description: GA, preview, gated, open weights, announced only, and so on.
            data_tests: [not_null]
          - name: top_tier
            description: yes when the model was the developer's most capable model or a new flagship generation; blank on excluded rows.
            data_tests:
              - accepted_values:
                  arguments:
                    values: ['yes', 'no']
          - name: notes
            description: Reason for exclusion, date conflicts and counting decisions.
          - name: source_url
            description: The single source the row relies on most.
            data_tests: [not_null]
          - name: _source_file
            description: File the row was loaded from.
          - name: _loaded_at
            description: Load timestamp.

with

source as (

    select * from {{ source('research', 'frontier_model_candidates') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        {{ slugify('developer') }} || '__' || {{ slugify('model') }} as release_id,
        {{ slugify('developer') }} as lab_id,
        trim(developer) as developer_name,
        trim(model) as model_name,
        cast("date" as date) as release_date,
        "window" as source_essay_window,
        counted = 'yes' as is_counted,
        case top_tier
            when 'yes' then true
            when 'no' then false
        end as is_top_tier,
        nullif(trim(tier), '') as tier,
        trim(release_type) as release_type,
        nullif(trim(notes), '') as notes,
        source_url,
        regexp_extract(source_url, '^https?://(www\.)?([^/]+)', 2) as source_domain,
        _source_file,
        _loaded_at

    from source

)

select * from renamed

version: 2

models:
  - name: stg_research__release_candidates
    description: >
      The research CSV, one row per candidate release, renamed and typed. `window` is renamed
      (it is a reserved word in DuckDB) and kept as `source_essay_window` so the intermediate
      layer can re-derive it from the date and test the two against each other.
    columns:
      - name: release_id
        description: Surrogate key, slugify(developer) || '__' || slugify(model).
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: lab_id
        description: slugify(developer); joins to seed_labs.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('seed_labs')
                field: lab_id
      - name: developer_name
        description: Lab or company as written in the research.
      - name: model_name
        description: Model name as written in the research.
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: release_date
        description: Announcement date under the METHODOLOGY 4.5 dating rule.
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: source_essay_window
        description: The window the researcher assigned (before, after, outside).
      - name: is_counted
        description: True when the row meets the inclusion rules (METHODOLOGY 4.2).
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: is_top_tier
        description: The researcher's top_tier flag (METHODOLOGY 4.6); null on excluded rows.
      - name: tier
        description: Position in the developer's lineup; null when the research left it blank.
        data_tests:
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('seed_tier_map')
                field: tier
      - name: release_type
        description: Release type as written in the research.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('seed_release_type_map')
                field: release_type
      - name: notes
        description: Research notes (exclusion reasons, date conflicts, counting decisions).
      - name: source_url
        description: Main supporting source.
      - name: source_domain
        description: Host of source_url without a leading www.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('seed_source_domains')
                field: source_domain
      - name: _source_file
        description: File the row was loaded from.
      - name: _loaded_at
        description: Load timestamp.
